memory_candidates.content: In CSLib module-system files, a defeq wrapper whose body lives in an @[expose] public section must import the module providing the wrapped definition via 'public import', not plain 'import', or downstream consumers of the exposed body fail.

When a Lean 4 inductive derives only DecidableEq, BEq resolves through instBEqOfDecidableEq; lemmas in a section carrying an unrelated [Hashable A] variable need 'omit [Hashable A] in' to avoid the unusedSectionVars env linter.
